rationale: The proposed topology enhances input matching and gain flatness by adding a source degeneration resistor and a shunt feedback capacitor, which improve S11 across the band and reduce ripple in S21 by stabilizing the input impedance and increasing bandwidth. This addresses the binding constraints of S21_ripple_db and S11_max_db while maintaining low power and low noise via careful placement of the feedback element to avoid degrading NF or increasing current.
